topic: How LLMs learn, taught to the viewer through one running example: 'the tea is getting... cold'
narrator_voice: Warm, patient, elderly teacher speaking directly to you. Poses a small puzzle, waits a beat, then explains plainly.
cast: a stout elderly man with a broad kind face, grey hair pulled into a small topknot, a long grey beard and heavy grey sideburns, thick dark eyebrows, warm half-closed eyes, wearing loose layered green robes with gold trim, wide cream sleeves and a brown sash, smiling warmly.

scenes.english: First Lesson: Guessing the Next Word
scenes.sound: tea pouring into a clay cup, a single guzheng note

scenes.narration: Finish this for me. The tea is getting... cold. You knew. The machine knows too, and that is its only skill: the next word.
scenes.video_prompt: medium close-up across a low wooden table in a small tea shop with paper lanterns, a stout elderly man with a broad kind face, grey hair pulled into a small topknot, a long grey beard and heavy grey sideburns, thick dark eyebrows, warm half-closed eyes, wearing loose layered green robes with gold trim, wide cream sleeves and a brown sash, smiling warmly, looking straight into the camera and speaking to the viewer, mouth moving as he talks, holds up an unrolled paper scroll with a short line of handwriting, covers the last word with his palm, raises his eyebrows at the camera as if waiting, then lifts his palm and nods, warm amber lantern light, steam from a teacup, no on-screen text
scenes.sound: quiet tea shop, erhu far away

scenes.narration: Inside it, every word is a place on a table. Tea sits near cup, and far from sword. Closeness is meaning. Nothing more.
scenes.video_prompt: overhead shot of a wide wooden table, a stout elderly man with a broad kind face, grey hair pulled into a small topknot, a long grey beard and heavy grey sideburns, thick dark eyebrows, warm half-closed eyes, wearing loose layered green robes with gold trim, wide cream sleeves and a brown sash, smiling warmly, looking straight into the camera and speaking to the viewer, mouth moving as he talks, sets a small teacup down right beside a clay teapot so they touch, then slides a sheathed sword away with two fingers until it rests at the far edge of the table, then taps the space between cup and pot, warm lantern light, watercolor wood grain, no on-screen text
scenes.sound: ceramic set on wood, a sword scraping across the table, wind chimes

scenes.narration: Pour water through many strainers. Each layer keeps a little and passes the rest. One cup at the bottom: the word that scored highest.
scenes.video_prompt: medium shot, a stout elderly man with a broad kind face, grey hair pulled into a small topknot, a long grey beard and heavy grey sideburns, thick dark eyebrows, warm half-closed eyes, wearing loose layered green robes with gold trim, wide cream sleeves and a brown sash, smiling warmly, looking straight into the camera and speaking to the viewer, mouth moving as he talks, pours hot water from a kettle into the top of a tall tower of stacked bamboo tea strainers, the water trickling down through every layer, a few leaves caught in each, into a single clay cup at the bottom, he lifts that cup toward the camera, steam rising, warm lantern light, no on-screen text
scenes.sound: water trickling through bamboo, pipa a few notes

scenes.narration: It guessed warm. The scroll said cold. That gap is the lesson. Each one nudges the guess a little closer. A trillion nudges, and it knows.
scenes.video_prompt: bright dry courtyard, packed sand floor, low camera close to the sand, a stout elderly man with a broad kind face, grey hair pulled into a small topknot, a long grey beard and heavy grey sideburns, thick dark eyebrows, warm half-closed eyes, wearing loose layered green robes with gold trim, wide cream sleeves and a brown sash, smiling warmly, kneels and looking straight into the camera and speaking to the viewer, mouth moving as he talks, draws two small circles in the sand with a wooden stick, a hand's width apart, draws a short line between them for the gap, then with his palm pushes the left circle a little toward the right one, and again, and again, until they touch, warm sunlight, watercolor stone wall behind, no on-screen text
scenes.sound: stick scratching in sand, birdsong, bamboo flute far away
sudden quiet, kettle steam hiss, low horn drone

scenes.narration: Nobody told it what is true. Only what was written. Write a lie ten thousand times, and it will say the lie warmly.
scenes.video_prompt: dusk in the tea shop, lanterns lit, a stout elderly man with a broad kind face, grey hair pulled into a small topknot, a long grey beard and heavy grey sideburns, thick dark eyebrows, warm half-closed eyes, wearing loose layered green robes with gold trim, wide cream sleeves and a brown sash, smiling warmly, looking straight into the camera and speaking to the viewer, mouth moving as he talks, holds up one handwritten page, sets it on a tall stack of identical copies of the same page, then pats the stack gently with a rueful smile, warm amber and deep blue palette, no on-screen text

scenes.narration: So ask it what people usually say. Do not ask it what is so. Now. Your tea really is getting cold.
scenes.video_prompt: static close-up, a stout elderly man with a broad kind face, grey hair pulled into a small topknot, a long grey beard and heavy grey sideburns, thick dark eyebrows, warm half-closed eyes, wearing loose layered green robes with gold trim, wide cream sleeves and a brown sash, smiling warmly, looking straight into the camera and speaking to the viewer, mouth moving as he talks, then glances down at the teacup in his hands, chuckles, and lifts it toward the camera as if offering it, steam curling up, eyes crinkling into a smile, hold on the smile, warm lantern light, no on-screen text
scenes.sound: a sip, wooden tiles clicking in the background, guzheng plucked slowly
